requirements.requirement_text: The Bid Factory solution must continuously monitor B2B procurement portals and incoming RFPs for dedicated teams.
The platform MUST maintain a continually growing, searchable answer library containing all past Q&A, win/loss results, pricing calls, and compliance documents.
The system shall automatically read each incoming RFP, dynamically match requirements to existing library answers, and autonomously compose missing responses.
The unified workflow must build a comprehensive final response with a built-in compliance checklist and integrated scheduling for human reviews/approvals.
